zh.title: 新春音乐会
zh.summary: 新春文化音乐会：围绕演出呈现提供制作统筹与支持。
zh.preview: 音乐是此次文化交流的主体。项目需要将演出支持与制作统筹衔接，使艺术呈现有相应的执行配合。
zh.role: Vivian Adventure 参与音乐会制作统筹与演出支持，将制作层面的配合工作围绕演出需要组织起来。
zh.context: 《唐诗的回响》新春音乐会在伦敦举行，由中国对外文化交流协会主办。多国歌唱家以中文演绎根据唐诗创作的音乐作品，通过演出开展文化交流。

narrativeSections.heading: 以演出为中心的制作支持
narrativeSections.text: 音乐会的文化内容由艺术家通过表演传达。本案中，制作统筹与演出支持是连接活动安排和艺术呈现的工作；我们的参与集中在这两个相互配合的环节。

outcomes: 本案的交付是音乐会制作与演出支持，体现文化演出项目的执行配合能力。

en.title: New Year Concert
en.summary: Production coordination and performance support for a London New Year cultural concert.
en.preview: The concert used music as a setting for cultural exchange. The production assignment connected coordination with the support needed around the performance.
en.role: Vivian Adventure contributed to production coordination and performance support, organising its production contribution around the needs of the concert.
en.context: The Echoes of Tang Poetry New Year concert took place in London, organised by the China International Culture Association. Singers from different countries performed Chinese-language works based on Tang poetry as part of a cultural exchange programme.

narrativeSections.heading: Production in service of performance
narrativeSections.text: The artists carried the cultural programme through their performance. Production coordination and performance support connected the practical arrangements with that presentation. Our involvement centred on these two related parts of the concert.

outcomes: The delivery was the concert’s production and performance support contribution, demonstrating execution support for a cultural performance.
